what: When a section in the middle of a dark page touches the screen at all, its background turns paper color (an inverted panel) with 1s ease-in and the top and bottom border bands grow to 52vw. When the section has fully passed above or is still below, it darkens again with 1s ease-out — repeating on every entry and exit. An inn’s first page that goes from an ink-black page to bright paper only for the facility About

options.[data-fx-part=sheet]: Flipped background plate (the very back inside the section, required) — to add a pattern, overwrite this plate’s background
options.[data-fx-part=band-top] · [data-fx-part=: Top and bottom border strip (optional) — the original is a golden cloud and ink mist image
options.fx:show: Fires every time it enters the screen

from.where: index.html .kh-inv (original top.js background inversion — when js-top-fade-in-out overlaps the screen it gets fade-in, passing above gives fade-out-top, below gives fade-out-bottom, p-top-inversion-bg:has(.fade-in) opacity 1·1s ease-in, ::before·::after height 52vw)
